justification: Changes which Part's scope the tagger applies to Parramatta DCP rules, which feeds the zones and project types each rule is served to

falsifiable_check.fails_when: a rule's Part disagrees with an external answer: the plan's own cover pages and printed page labels in the Parramatta DCP PDF (cover pages 4,12,46,137,177,269,289,396,1079,1466,1499,1509 read from the PDF; every one of 8,674 printed labels 'n - x' agrees), or a rule is widened to all zones and all project types compared with origin/main
falsifiable_check.observed_red: On origin/main the tagger scopes 191 served Parramatta rules by a heading from another Part (appendix rows on pdf 1509-1563 headed '8.0'/'13.0' take Part 8's area-limited scope); test_a_heading_from_another_part_takes_the_pages_part fails there. Before/after over all 8,887 served rows (tag_with_provenance, live rows, 2026-10-20): 46 change, all Part 12, 0 widened.

pre_impl.existing_data: regulatory_provisions.pdf_page (100% on served Parramatta rows); the plan PDF's cover pages
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: a row with no heading code, or a bare-number heading, is not re-pointed by the page; existing rows keep their stored tags until the tagger is re-run on them
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: rows tagged after merge; existing rows need a re-tag run (separate, user approval)

falsifiable_check.fails_when: the Part disagrees with the plan's cover pages, or a rule is widened

functions.name: _get_config_driven
functions.input: a rule's text, its document id, its stored Part and its PDF page
functions.output: the scope entry of the Part the rule belongs to, or None when no Part entry applies
functions.if_none: no pdf_page or a page outside every range: behaviour unchanged from before

values.if_missing: no page Part; the heading decides as before

break_it.scenario: a bare-number heading such as '# 3 Metre Wide Lanes' on a Part 8 page
break_it.what_happens: re-pointing it to Part 8 would replace its text-derived types with all and widen it
break_it.how: only a dotted section number is corrected by the page

break_it.scenario: a row with no heading code on a Part 8 page
break_it.what_happens: a Part entry's all would overwrite 'retail, cafe and restaurant' types and show it for a house
break_it.how: rows with no code keep their text reading

break_it.scenario: a new version of the PDF moves the cover pages
break_it.what_happens: page ranges would name the wrong Part for the new version
break_it.how: accepted: the file names its source PDF version; a re-extraction from a new version must re-read the cover pages

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes — re-tag the 46 Parramatta appendix rows (needs user approval), then check they no longer carry Part 8 scope
